dependency: Task 188 output, eighteen-row port 8012 match and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 189 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only and all selected rows remain NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Meadowhall Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Meadowhall site exposes shops, restaurants, cinema, centre map and the published address Meadowhall Centre, Sheffield S9 1EP.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported for the shopping-centre entity. Exact centre and parcel boundaries remain pending.

features.name: Chatsworth House
features.official_source_evidence: Chatsworth House Trust identifies the asset as one of Derbyshire's finest country houses at Chatsworth, Bakewell, Derbyshire DE45 1PP.
features.classification_finding: The standalone country-house identity is strong, but Detached Home is a broad product taxonomy rather than the site's current visitor/heritage use. Preserve only with a documented heritage-house policy.

features.name: SEGRO Logistics Park East Midlands Gateway
features.official_source_evidence: The official scheme site identifies a 700-acre logistics development with more than 4.5 million sq ft of logistics accommodation, a strategic rail freight interchange and multiple plots.
features.classification_finding: The tracked entity is a multi-building logistics park, not one Industrial Unit. A specific warehouse or plot must be selected before any exact geometry binding.

features.name: Cabot Circus
features.official_source_evidence: The official Cabot Circus site presents the destination through Shop, Eat & Drink, See & Do and visitor-planning sections and describes it as a Bristol city-centre shopping spot.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is supported under a dominant-use shopping-centre policy. Exact complex boundary and separation from associated offices, hotel and apartments remain pending.

features.name: Westfield Stratford City
features.official_source_evidence: The official Westfield Stratford City page lists shops, food and drink, entertainment, centre map, parking and visitor services for the named shopping centre.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported for the centre entity, while exact centre/parcel boundaries remain pending.

features.name: Landmark Pinnacle
features.official_source_evidence: The official development site markets Landmark Pinnacle apartments and identifies the named residential tower development.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is strongly supported. Exact tower footprint and parcel evidence remain pending.
